environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private VPC subnet. Traffic arrives from internal corporate network via VPN peering. No application-layer proxy or filtering between clients and the Flask service. The instance runs Amazon Linux 2 with Python 3.9, and the app is managed by systemd. Security group allows TCP/8080 from 10.0.0.0/8. The SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/data with standard ext4 filesystem permissions (rw for app user).

config.network: VPC private subnet, SG allows 10.0.0.0/8 -> TCP/8080
config.storage: EBS gp3 mounted at /var/data, ext4, 0644 db file owned by app user
config.proxy: none - NLB passes TCP directly to instance
